authored_by: this lane, by hand, at the owner's instruction
WHAT_THIS_IS: A MOCKUP. Every Hebrew string below was typed by hand from memory. None of it was copied from any text this project holds, none of it traces to a record, and none of it is a reading. It exists to show what each part of the frame LOOKS LIKE when it works, because the books that carry these marks are not published and two of them are not held at all.
WHY_FROM_MEMORY_IS_SAID_OUT_LOUD: A mark shown alone is a glyph; a mark shown inside a passage is the mark doing its work. Passages mean real verses, and typing a real verse from memory is the thing this project refuses everywhere else. It is permitted here and nowhere else, the pointing and cantillation may differ from any edition, nothing here may be cited or compared against a manuscript, and when these books build these drawings come down.
THE_LAW_EVERY_CARD_OBEYS: The C0 never moves. Whatever the reader selects, the ink stands exactly as the source wrote it. Selection governs what is DEFINED, never what is DISPLAYED.

TWO_KINDS_OF_SELECTION.EXCLUDES: The branches are different meanings and choosing one makes the other wrong here. One English at a time. Marked in the line by an underline under the half in focus, because both halves are ink the scribe wrote. Only written/read is this kind.
TWO_KINDS_OF_SELECTION.EMPHASIZES: The parts are one reading assembled. Nothing is excluded, so every English shows at once, joined by a plus. Selection says which part is in focus. The abbreviation and the maqaf are this kind — and for the abbreviation there is nothing to underline, because the expansion is nowhere on the page.

demonstrations.title: written one way, read another

c0.before: וַיְדַבְּרוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּים לַמֶּלֶךְ אֲרָמִית מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי אֱמַר חֶלְמָא
c0.english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic: O king, live forever — tell the dream to your servant, and we will declare the meaning.

demonstrations.in_the_card: The English says which branch it belongs to, in words. The underline in the line points at the same half. Neither is enough alone: an underline without a label leaves the reader guessing which English they are reading.
demonstrations.the_card_says: One word block, one card, two branches. The ink shows both because the scribe wrote both. Selecting a half underlines it where it already stands and shows that half's English only — one English at a time, and neither chosen for the reader.
demonstrations.key: keyed — one key per branch, delimiters stripped
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: This site holds Daniel and cannot build it: 332 of its surfaces carry literal HTML markup where the text should be.

demonstrations.title: two words joined into one unit, and a lattice over the lattice

c0.english: And the whole earth was of one language and one speech.

nested.why: An atom of a maqaf is a word, and a word carries prefixes. So the maqaf's lattice sits OVER an ordinary COMPspan rather than replacing it, and its atoms divide again underneath.

demonstrations.in_the_card: Both Englishes show whichever atom you press, joined by a plus, because a maqaf is not offering a choice of meaning — it says these words are read as one. The press moves the emphasis and the underline; it removes nothing.
demonstrations.the_card_says: One C0 and more than one W. The W set is every contiguous interval of the atoms, which overlap and therefore partition nothing — that overlap is exactly why a reading line may join atoms only, and never an interval.
demonstrations.key: keyed, with the joiner kept in its original position
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Live on the shelf and broken: 64,791 surfaces carry a maqaf and not one of their keys does, so every maqaf word is unkeyed, opens no card, and gets no definition. The frame's own rule says the key preserves it.

demonstrations.title: one meaning, two surfaces — and only the ink can tell them apart

c0.before: בְּכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא גְּדֻלָּתוֹ שֶׁל
c0.english: In every place where you find his greatness, there you find his humility.

cells.english: the Holy One, blessed be He

demonstrations.in_the_card: Both halves show whichever is selected — the abbreviation stays under the expansion and the expansion stays under the abbreviation. They cannot be separated anywhere except in the ink: no level above C0 is abbreviated-form-only, and none is expanded-form-only either. Hiding half would assert a separation that does not exist.
demonstrations.the_card_says: An ordinary COMPspan with two alternatives, not a special case. Selecting the second changes not one letter of what is printed — the line still reads as the source wrote it. There is nothing to underline in the expansion, because those three words are nowhere on the page; the plus does that work instead, saying these glosses are one meaning assembled rather than three words defined.
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Nothing. This one works on the published site today.

demonstrations.title: an open section — the next begins on a new line

c0.before: וַיֹּאמַר יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן יִשְׁאָג וּמִירוּשָׁלִַם יִתֵּן קוֹלוֹ וְאָבְלוּ נְאוֹת הָרֹעִים וְיָבֵשׁ רֹאשׁ הַכַּרְמֶל
c0.english: And he said: the LORD roars from Zion and utters his voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withers.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The word — petuchah, open — and what it does: this section ends here, and the next begins on a fresh line. If the reader cannot give the break its line, the card says so in plain English rather than drawing nothing.
demonstrations.key: unkeyed — the letter abbreviates a word and is not an occurrence of that letter
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Amos is held for the same markup defect. Eight books that do arrive clean arrived flattened, with the marks already gone.

demonstrations.title: a closed section — the next begins after a gap, same line

c0.before: לַכֹּל זְמָן וְעֵת לְכָל חֵפֶץ תַּחַת הַשָּׁמָיִם
c0.english: To everything there is a season, and a time to every purpose under heaven. — A time to be born, and a time to die.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The word — setumah, closed — and what it does: this section ends, and the next begins on the same line, after a gap. A reader that draws this the same as an open section has erased a distinction the scribe made, and has to say which one it cannot honor.
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Ecclesiastes is held: 40 of its surfaces carry literal markup.

demonstrations.title: two marks bracketing a passage set apart

c0.site: וַיְהִי בִּנְסֹעַ הָאָרֹן וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה קוּמָה יְהוָה וְיָפֻצוּ אֹיְבֶיךָ וְיָנֻסוּ מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ וּבְנֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהוָה רִבְבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
c0.english: And when the ark set out, Moses said: Arise, O LORD, and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you. And when it rested he said: Return, O LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.

demonstrations.the_card_says: The mark's name, and what the tradition says with it: this passage stands apart. Whether a mark opens, closes, or stands alone is recorded — in Psalm 107 these stand singly, here two of them bracket the passage — and no partner is demanded. The tradition counts these two verses as a book of their own, which is the strongest form the claim takes.
demonstrations.key: unkeyed — a punctuation character, not the letter nun
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Seven of these are in the body. Numbers is one of the eight books that arrived flattened, so the copy we hold has none of them.

demonstrations.title: the book's own count of itself, at the end of the book
demonstrations.at: the last line of a book

c0.after: חצי הספר בפסוקים · חצי הספר בתיבות · חצי הספר באותיות
c0.english: The total of the verses of the book — the midpoint of the book by verses · by words · by letters.

demonstrations.why_no_numbers_are_shown: The honest states are NOT_HELD, HELD_UNCOUNTED, VERIFIED and CONTRADICTED, and HELD_UNCOUNTED may not be cited anywhere a reader can see. A figure typed here from memory would be citing an assumption twice over. This is the only mark that makes a checkable claim, so recording it is not attesting it — the half has to be counted.
demonstrations.the_card_says: That this is not a word of the book, and what the scribes recorded here — then the ordinary card beneath it. The banner stands above a normal card, never instead of one.
demonstrations.key: keyed, and the only OFF kind that is — ordinary Hebrew words meaning what they say
demonstrations.blocks_the_real_thing: Nobody holds it. The end-of-book masorah is missing from every Tanakh stream either lane has.
